name: .alpha.-tocopherol + hydrated silica + sodium fluoride
uses: Uses ■ Keeps teeth white and strong. ■ Keeps the oral cavity clean. ■ Refreshes the oral cavity. ■ Helps prevent cavities with fluoride. ■ Removes bad breath. ■ Enhances the aesthetic effect. ■ Helps prevent gingivitis, periodontitis (pyorrhea), and periodontal disease. ■ Removes dental plaque (anti-plaque).
otcwarn: Warnings ■ The fluoride concentration of this toothpaste is 1,450 ppm. ■ Do not swallow. Rinse your mouth thoroughly after use. ■ If irritation or any abnormality occurs, such as damage to the gums or inside of the mouth, discontinue use and consult a physician or dentist. ■ For children 6 years of age and under, use only a pea-sized amount under adult supervision to minimize swallowing. Do not allow the child to suck or swallow the toothpaste. ■ If a child 6 years of age and under accidentally swallows a large amount, consult a physician or dentist immediately. ■ Keep out of reach of children 6 years of age and under. ■ This toothpaste contains more than 1,000 ppm fluoride. Consult a physician or dentist before use by children 6 years of age and under.
